question: Which embered secret will ignite your heart?
intro_environment: A sprawling twilight vista where glowing embers drift across a crimson sky, stretching to horizons of distant cinder peaks.
intro_camera: A sweeping panoramic shot from a high cliff, capturing the entire embered realm in a wide-angle frame.
intro_couple_action: The couple, a curious pair of travelers, wander across the glowing dunes, their silhouettes barely visible against the fiery sky.

choices.title: Crimson Reef
choices.description: A vast, open lake of molten glass, reflecting the embered stars and bordered by jagged obsidian cliffs.
choices.composition: Horizontal horizon with a wide foreground of shimmering water, couple off-center in the middle distance.
choices.camera: Wide-angle low angle looking slightly upward to emphasize the expansive sky.
choices.dominant_palette: Fiery reds, orange, and molten gold.
choices.couple_action: The couple stands at the water's edge, gazing into the glowing depths.

choices.title: Subterranean Ember Cavern
choices.description: A deep underground cavern lit by bioluminescent fungi, with stalagmites shaped like twisted roots and a river of liquid crystal.
choices.composition: Vertical composition with a central path leading into the darkness, couple positioned near a glowing stalactite.
choices.camera: Medium shot from a slightly elevated angle, focusing on the couple and the luminous fungi.
choices.couple_action: The couple is crouching, following a trail of glowing fungi.

choices.title: Coastal Cliff of Cinder
choices.description: A towering cliff of blackened stone overlooking a sea of ash, with wind-whipped ash dunes and a lighthouse made of obsidian.
choices.composition: Rule of thirds with the cliff edge on the right, couple standing near the ledge, distant ash sea below.
choices.camera: Wide shot from a low angle, capturing the cliff's height and the couple's smallness.
choices.dominant_palette: Dark greys, ash whites, and hints of amber.
choices.couple_action: The couple holds a lantern, casting a warm glow on the cliff face.

choices.title: Mountain Sanctuary of Ash
choices.description: A secluded mountain peak covered in ash forests, with a crystal clear lake reflecting the aurora, and ancient stone monoliths.
choices.composition: Diagonal lines leading from the foreground monoliths to the distant lake, couple positioned near the monolith.
choices.camera: Panoramic sweep capturing the peak and the lake.
choices.dominant_palette: Soft greys, silvery blues, and pale amber.
choices.couple_action: The couple is seated on a stone, watching the aurora dance across the lake.
